application.title: Customer Application Form — Savings Plan
application.intro: I, {{customer_name}} (Mobile {{customer_mobile}}), apply to {{company}} to open the savings plan described below and request that my application be processed on the terms stated in this form and in the Terms & Conditions of the plan.

clauses.b: Plan: {{plan_name}}. Amount: {{amount}}. Tenure: {{tenure}}. Indicative rate: {{rate}} p.a. Illustrated maturity value: {{maturity_value}}. Account reference: {{acct_no}}.
I declare that all details and documents given by me are true, correct and complete, and that I will inform {{company}} promptly if any of them changes.
I have provided my identity and address proof (Aadhaar / PAN / other officially valid document) and consent to their verification as required by law.
The money deposited under this plan comes from my lawful sources and is not connected with any unlawful activity.
I nominate {{nominee}} to receive the proceeds of this plan in the event of my demise, subject to applicable law.
I will pay deposits only against an official receipt of {{company}} and will not hand cash to any person without a receipt.
I have read and accept the Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy, Grievance Redressal Policy and Refund & Cancellation Policy of the plan.
I authorise {{company}} to contact me on the mobile number given for matters related to this plan.

consent.title: Customer Consent Form
consent.intro: I, {{customer_name}}, give the following consents to {{company}} in connection with my savings plan {{plan_name}} ({{acct_no}}). I understand that I may withdraw a consent in writing, subject to what the law requires {{company}} to keep.

clauses.t: Collection and use of my details
clauses.b: I consent to {{company}} collecting, storing and using my personal details, KYC documents and photograph to open and run my plan.
I consent to verification of my KYC with the issuing authorities and approved verification services, as required by law.
I consent to receiving calls, SMS, WhatsApp messages and app notifications about deposits, due dates, maturity, offers and service matters. Marketing messages can be stopped at any time.
I consent to my details being shared only with service providers, auditors, regulators and authorities who need them for the plan, under confidentiality.
I agree that my password confirmation, drawn signature and records kept in the PFS app are valid evidence of my acceptance.
I consent to a live photo and approximate location being captured at deposit or verification time to prevent fraud.
I may withdraw consent by writing to the Grievance Officer. Withdrawal does not affect actions already taken, and may mean the plan cannot continue.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: {{company}} respects your privacy. This policy explains what we collect, why, and how we protect it. It applies to the PFS app and to savings plans.

clauses.b: Name, mobile number, address, date of birth, KYC documents, photograph, nominee details, bank details, plan and deposit records, device and approximate location data, and your communications with us.
To open and run your plan, verify identity, prevent fraud, issue receipts and certificates, meet legal duties, and improve our service.
We do not sell your data. We share it only with service providers, auditors, regulators and authorities where needed, under confidentiality.
Passwords are stored in hashed form, access is role-based and logged, and sensitive records are protected on our servers. No system is perfectly secure; report any suspected misuse to us at once.
We keep records for as long as your plan runs and for the period required by law afterwards, then delete or anonymise them.
You may ask to see, correct or update your details, withdraw consent, or ask for deletion where the law allows.
The app asks for camera (KYC and live proof), location (fraud checks) and notifications only for these purposes.
Plans are for adults. A plan for a minor must be opened by a parent or guardian.
We may update this policy and will show the date of the latest version in the app.
{{grievance_officer}}, {{address}}, Ph: {{phone}}.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions — Savings Plans
terms.intro: These Terms & Conditions apply to every savings plan offered by {{company}}, including {{plan_name}}. By opening a plan you accept them.

clauses.b: Any adult resident Indian with completed KYC and a mobile number may open a plan within the amount and tenure limits shown for that plan.
A plan starts only when {{company}} confirms receipt of the first deposit and issues a Bond Certificate. A request alone does not create a plan.
Deposits must be made only against an official receipt of {{company}}. Deposits paid to anyone else without a receipt are not recognised.
The illustrated benefit is calculated at the plan rate stated on your Bond Certificate. The maturity value payable is the value on the Bond Certificate, adjusted for any missed instalments.
If instalments are missed, the maturity value reduces in proportion to the deposits actually paid.
A plan may be closed before maturity only on written request approved by the Company. The benefit is then paid at a rate lower than the plan rate, as shown in the Refund & Cancellation Policy.
The nominee named in the application is entitled to the proceeds on the holder's demise, subject to law and proof of identity.
A plan and its Bond Certificate cannot be sold, pledged or transferred.
Tax, including tax deducted at source, applies as per law and is the holder's responsibility.
The Company may change, withdraw or add plans. A change affects only new plans; running plans keep the terms on their Bond Certificate.
These terms are governed by the laws of India. Courts at Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh have jurisdiction.

service.title: Customer Service Agreement
service.intro: This Customer Service Agreement is made on {{date}} between {{company}} ("the Company") and {{customer_name}} ("the Customer") for service on the plan {{plan_name}} ({{acct_no}}).

clauses.b: The Company will open and maintain the plan, record deposits, issue receipts and the Bond Certificate, send reminders and statements, and pay the maturity amount on time.
The Customer will give true information, keep the mobile number and password secret, pay deposits only against receipts, and report errors promptly.
Receipts are issued at the time of payment. Requests are answered within {{grievance_days}} days and complaints are handled under the Grievance Redressal Policy.
The Company charges no fee to open or run a plan unless shown in the Terms & Conditions or on the Bond Certificate.
Personal data is used as described in the Privacy Policy and the Customer Consent Form.
Either party may end this agreement by closing the plan under the Refund & Cancellation Policy. The Company may end it if KYC or information is found false.
The Company is liable for deposits it has receipted. It is not liable for money paid without a receipt or for loss caused by the Customer sharing credentials.
Disputes will first go to the Grievance Officer; unresolved disputes are subject to the courts at Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.

grievance.title: Grievance Redressal Policy
grievance.intro: {{company}} wants every complaint heard and resolved fairly and promptly. This policy tells you how to complain and what to expect.

clauses.b: Use Raise a complaint in the PFS app, call {{phone}}, visit any branch, or write to the Grievance Officer: {{grievance_officer}}, {{address}}.
Every complaint gets a number (PFS-CMP-xxxxx) and is recorded in the Complaint Register.
We acknowledge your complaint immediately in the app and by message.
We will resolve or reply with a reasoned answer within {{grievance_days}} days of receiving the complaint.
If you are not satisfied, ask for your complaint to be reviewed by the Grievance Officer, and then by the CEO / Founder.
If your complaint is not resolved to your satisfaction, you may approach the authority that regulates the Company or the courts, as the law provides.
No customer will be treated unfairly for making a complaint.
The Company reviews complaint records regularly to remove the causes of repeated complaints.

refund.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
refund.intro: This policy explains when you can cancel a plan and what you get back from {{company}}.

clauses.b: A request that has not started (no first deposit confirmed) can be cancelled free of charge. If any money was handed over, it is refunded in full.
If you cancel within 7 days of the plan starting, all deposits are refunded in full, without benefit.
After the cooling-off period, premature closure returns the deposits plus a reduced benefit calculated at the plan rate less 2% for the time the plan ran.
At maturity the maturity value on the Bond Certificate is paid, adjusted for missed instalments.
Refunds are paid to your own registered bank account within 7 working days of approval.
If a deposit was wrongly made or duplicated, it is returned on proof within 7 working days.
On the holder's demise the proceeds are paid to the nominee on proof of identity and a death certificate.
If you disagree with a refund decision, use the Grievance Redressal Policy.

agent.title: Employee / Agent Agreement
agent.intro: This Agreement is made on {{date}} between {{company}} ("the Company") and {{party_name}} ("the {{party_role}}"), {{party_city}}, to sell and service savings plans on the Company's behalf.

clauses.b: The Company appoints the {{party_role}} to introduce customers and collect applications and deposits for the Company's savings plans in the area assigned.
Explain plans truthfully, complete KYC properly, issue only official receipts, and give customers the plan terms.
All money collected belongs to the Company. It must be deposited with the Company the same working day, with receipt records. Keeping, lending or using customer money is a serious breach.
No false promises of returns, no pressure, no collection without receipt, no sharing of customer data, and respectful behaviour at all times.
The {{party_role}} is paid as agreed in writing ({{commission}}). No other payment may be taken from customers.
Customer and Company information must be kept confidential during and after this Agreement.
The {{party_role}} will complete the training given and follow the Company's policies and the law.
Either side may end this Agreement with notice as agreed. The Company may end it at once for breach of cash, conduct or confidentiality rules.
On ending, the {{party_role}} returns all receipt books, ID cards, devices and records.
The {{party_role}} is responsible for loss caused by dishonesty or breach of this Agreement.
Indian law applies; courts at Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh have jurisdiction.

partner.title: Business Partner Agreement
partner.intro: This Agreement is made on {{date}} between {{company}} ("the Company") and {{party_name}} ("the Business Partner"), {{party_city}}, to introduce customers to the Company's savings plans.

clauses.b: The Business Partner introduces customers for the Company's savings plans. The Company alone accepts deposits, opens plans and issues Bond Certificates.
The Company pays {{commission}} on plans that start through the Business Partner, after the first deposit is confirmed, as per the Company's payout rules.
The Business Partner will describe plans only as in the Company's approved material and will not promise returns.
The Business Partner will not collect, hold or handle customer deposits unless the Company has authorised it in writing.
The Business Partner will follow KYC, anti-money-laundering, data protection and other laws and the Company's policies.
Customer data shared with the Business Partner is used only for this purpose and kept confidential.
This Agreement continues until ended by either side with notice. The Company may end it at once for breach.
The Business Partner is not an employee of the Company and has no authority to bind it.
Each party is responsible for its own acts. The Business Partner is responsible for customer loss caused by its misstatements.
Indian law applies; courts at Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh have jurisdiction.
